the_rule_implemented.statement: Every refusal on the daily learning report now carries `cause`: PLUMBING (our own wiring did not deliver an input that exists) or NO_DATA_YET (the input genuinely does not exist -- a CORRECT refusal that stays).
the_rule_implemented.why: A gate that cannot go green is a broken gate -- and it cuts both ways. One undifferentiated red line teaches the reader to skim whether it is our dead job or an honest absence, and the two need opposite responses.
the_rule_implemented.surfaced_where: header line `REFUSALS: n OUR PLUMBING [...] | m no data yet [...]`, plus `report['refusal_census']` in the receipt.
